premises.text: Busy people need household help but refuse the coordination cost of stitching together many on-demand apps
premises.evidence_span: all of that takes time and coordination and the mental energy

premises.text: Alfred is a $99/month weekly in-person butler service layered on top of on-demand and local providers
premises.evidence_span: Alfred is actually a service layer. It sits on top of other on-demand and local services

premises.text: Customers set automatic recurring preferences; Alfred anticipates needs and coordinates providers in the background
premises.evidence_span: The magic of Alfred is you don't have to make requests. You set things to be automatic

premises.text: Vetted neighborhood Alfreds visit on fixed weekly days so chores can be grouped for scale economies
premises.evidence_span: they visit you and your neighbors every week on set days, so they group chores, which gives us economies of scale

premises.text: Building partnerships enable turning on whole neighborhoods quickly
premises.evidence_span: we partner with buildings, which allows us to turn on neighborhoods overnight, making us scalable

premises.text: In-app payment and key access make household service seamless in one place
